The '''Oradam Peninsula''' was a peninsula on the north side of the island of [[Avilatan]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. It was located east of [[Oradam village]], and the [[Imperial Listening Post]] was located on a [[Unidentified Ord Mantell island|small island]] off the tip of the peninsula.
